review_kind: AI technical authoring; independent technical peer required; no native-speaker acceptance
note: Exact eighteen owner sources; normal scoped source-context gates, no catalog generation. Backend API scope is separate.

records.translation: 强度校准参考采集批次

records.source: Optional local CSV assigning acquisition sessions independently of plates. Use an exact filename column, including each merged NPY or selected reference TIFF/NPY suffix, and the selected session column. Every current sample and reference file must have one unique nonblank assignment. Blank keeps one session per plate. Default blank.
records.translation: 可选的本地 CSV 文件，用于独立于板分配采集批次。使用名称严格为 filename 的列，其中包含每个合并 NPY 文件或所选参考 TIFF/NPY 文件的扩展名，并使用所选的批次列。当前的每个样本文件和参考文件都必须具有唯一且非空的分配。留空则保持每块板一个批次。默认留空。

records.source: Exact column name in the sessions CSV that identifies an acquisition session. All fields in a session share reference gains and must use compatible measurement intensity planes and working units. Default session.
records.translation: 批次 CSV 中用于标识采集批次的精确列名。同一批次的所有视野共享参考增益，并且必须使用兼容的测量强度平面和工作单位。默认为 session。

records.source: Optional local folder of bead or reference-well images, replacing reference images inside the measured folder. Filenames keep the plate, well and field identity; selected reference wells still apply. NPY files use the merged channel and mask layout. TIFF files contain only intensity channels with explicit spatial and channel axes. No time or ambiguous page-axis interpretation is guessed. Default blank.
records.translation: 可选的本地微球或参考孔图像文件夹，用于替代被测文件夹内的参考图像。文件名保留板、孔和视野的标识；所选参考孔仍然适用。NPY 文件使用合并的通道和掩膜布局。TIFF 文件仅包含强度通道，并具有明确的空间轴和通道轴。不会猜测时间轴或含义不明的页面轴的解释。默认留空。

records.source: Exact acquisition session identifier to use as the gain reference. Blank uses the first session by name, or the sole session on the explicitly selected reference plate. If both plate and session are selected they must agree. A plate assigned to multiple sessions requires this choice. Default blank.
records.translation: 用作增益参考的精确采集批次标识。留空使用按名称排序的第一个批次，或明确选定的参考板上唯一的批次。如果同时选择板和批次，两者必须一致。一块板被分配到多个批次时必须指定此项。默认留空。

records.source: Calibrate intensities before measuring, using beads or reference wells acquired in each imaging session. By default each plate is a session. An optional sessions CSV assigns fields independently of plates; an external bead folder can supply the reference images. Gains match the selected reference session or plate; blank choices keep the first-by-name default. The existing camera-offset gain method is unchanged. Gains and reference content identities are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
records.translation: 在测量前，使用每个成像批次采集的微球或参考孔校准强度。默认每块板为一个批次。可选的批次 CSV 可独立于板分配视野；外部微球文件夹可提供参考图像。增益与所选参考批次或参考板匹配；留空保持按名称排序取第一个的默认行为。现有的相机偏置增益方法不变。增益和参考内容标识记录在 measurements.db:intensity_rescale 中。默认为 False。

records.source: Wells holding the same calibration sample in each acquisition session, such as ['A01'] or ['A01', 'P24']. References come from the selected external bead folder, or otherwise the measured merged folder. Every measured session must have a usable reference field. In-source reference wells are measured like any other well. Default None.
records.translation: 每个采集批次中装有相同校准样本的孔，例如 ['A01'] 或 ['A01', 'P24']。参考数据来自所选的外部微球文件夹，否则来自被测的合并文件夹。每个被测批次都必须具有可用的参考视野。源数据中的参考孔与其他孔一样进行测量。默认为 None。

records.source: Exact reference plate identifier from merged filenames, such as plate2. Without a sessions CSV, blank keeps the first plate by name. With explicit sessions, this plate must belong to one session, or pair it with an exact reference session on that plate. The selected plate must be present in the measured run. Default blank.
records.translation: 合并文件名中的精确参考板标识，例如 plate2。没有批次 CSV 时，留空保持按名称排序取第一块板。显式指定批次时，该板必须只属于一个批次，或与该板上的一个精确参考批次配对。所选板必须存在于本次测量运行中。默认留空。

records.source: How each reference field intensity is summarised after subtracting intensity_calibration_offset. foreground is the median above Otsu for sparse beads on a dark background; median uses all pixels for a uniformly stained reference well. Each acquisition session uses the median over its reference fields. Default foreground.
records.translation: 减去 intensity_calibration_offset 后，如何汇总各参考视野的强度。foreground 是高于 Otsu 阈值的像素中位数，适用于暗背景上的稀疏微球；median 使用所有像素，适用于均匀染色的参考孔。每个采集批次使用其参考视野的中位数。默认为 foreground。

records.key: A selected plate and session must agree; a plate with multiple sessions requires an explicit reference session.
records.source: A selected plate and session must agree; a plate with multiple sessions requires an explicit reference session.
records.translation: 所选板和批次必须一致；包含多个批次的板需要明确指定参考批次。

records.key: Calculate reference gains without running Measure or changing files.
records.source: Calculate reference gains without running Measure or changing files.
records.translation: 计算参考增益，不运行 Measure，也不更改文件。

records.key: Gains use the camera offset and selected reference wells or external reference images; images and measurements are unchanged.
records.source: Gains use the camera offset and selected reference wells or external reference images; images and measurements are unchanged.
records.translation: 增益使用相机偏置及所选参考孔或外部参考图像；图像和测量结果保持不变。

records.key: With session inputs, leave the reference session blank to use the first session by name, or the only session on the selected reference plate.
records.source: With session inputs, leave the reference session blank to use the first session by name, or the only session on the selected reference plate.
records.translation: 有批次输入时，留空参考批次可使用按名称排序的第一个批次，或所选参考板上唯一的批次。

records.key: Without session inputs, the selected reference plate is used; leave it blank to use the first plate by name.
records.source: Without session inputs, the selected reference plate is used; leave it blank to use the first plate by name.
records.translation: 没有批次输入时使用所选参考板；留空可使用按名称排序的第一块板。
